sites.name: iStock preview videos
sites.testResult: Downloaded the full file (5.6 MB): H.264 768x432, 24 fps, 29.8 s. Every frame decoded cleanly.
sites.notes: The link points straight at an MP4 file on iStock's media server (200 OK, video/mp4, resumable), so yt-dlp's generic downloader handles it with no extra options. The file name comes from the URL path. These are iStock's watermarked preview copies; the licensed full-resolution clip is not available this way.

sites.name: Puncher.tube
sites.testResult: Recipe found https://x-x-x.tube/embed/270856/; downloaded the full video through it (74.8 MB): H.264 1280x720 at 25 fps with AAC audio, 7:21. Every frame decoded cleanly.
sites.notes: yt-dlp has no puncher.tube extractor, and the generic extractor reports Unsupported URL: the page (behind Cloudflare, but served normally) has no video of its own, only an iframe to an embed on another host (x-x-x.tube/embed/<id>/). The generic extractor doesn't follow arbitrary iframes. The embed is a KVS player, which the generic extractor handles with no cookies, so the recipe finds the x-x-x.tube iframe and hands its URL to yt-dlp with the page as referer. The title comes from the embed (the page's og:title carries site boilerplate). This replaced a Python plugin, archived in sites/plugins-archive.

sites.name: HQporner
sites.testResult: Recipe found the mydaddy.cc player, read its 360p, 720p60 and 1080p60 sources, and picked 1080.mp4 on bigcdn.cc. Downloaded a 30-second sample of it as "Wide And Wet [128512-wide_and_wet].mp4": H.264 1920x1080 at ~60 fps with AAC audio; every frame decoded cleanly.
sites.notes: yt-dlp has no hqporner extractor and the generic extractor reports Unsupported URL: the page iframes a player from mydaddy.cc. Followed directly, that embed fails two ways: it returns an empty page without an hqporner referer, and it writes its <video> tag from a JavaScript string with every quote escaped, so yt-dlp's generic HTML5 parser sees each quality as a separate video with a garbled extension (mp4\") that it refuses to download. The recipe finds the mydaddy.cc iframe, fetches it with the page as referer, undoes the escaping, reads the <source> qualities (360p, 720p60, 1080p60), picks the tallest that fits the Quality setting, and gives yt-dlp that MP4 with the page title ("Wide And Wet") and the page's id. The video files need no referer or cookies. This replaced a Python plugin, archived in sites/plugins-archive.
